notes: Hand-computed expected outputs for the GHG calculation engine. A line is round3(converted × periodShare × kgCo2ePerUnit × accountingShare), each gas column alike; the period share is coveredDays/totalDays to six decimals half up (exactly 1 when every day is covered); conversions are DECIMAL64; a run total is the sum of its rounded lines; base-year shares are to two decimals half up; tonnes to three. Decimals are strings so no digit is lost; dates are ISO.
